title: Block Out Level 2 Walkthrough
summary: Block Out Level 2 opens with red up and yellow left, then turns into a vertical-column cleanup. Park blue in the upper-left corner, peel the white and black columns through the top lane, and only cash blue out last.

variants.gameVersion: current iOS and Android catalog checked 2026-08-03

boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 2 opens with red up and yellow left, then turns into a vertical-column cleanup. Park blue in the upper-left corner, peel the white and black columns through the top lane, and only cash blue out last.
landmarks: Block Out Level 2 opens with red up and yellow left, then turns into a vertical-column cleanup.
Park blue in the upper-left corner, peel the white and black columns through the top lane, and only cash blue out last.
The board mixes Red, Yellow, Blue and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: Red and yellow are the two opening clears.
Blue is a brace first and an exit block second.
If the board feels stuck, look for the color with the cleanest path and use that to regain space.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Move the red L-shaped block up through the top red gate.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Push the yellow T-shaped block left through the yellow side gate.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Slide the blue L into the upper-left corner and leave it parked there.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Raise the far-right white column and then lift the black column beside it into the top-right black gate.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Pull the tall middle white column up into the top-left white gate once the black corner is free.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Use the same top lane to remove the remaining white stack on the right side.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Send the last black column up through the black gate.

steps.title: Move 8
steps.instruction: Finish by dropping the parked blue L to the blue gate on the left wall.

failurePoints: Trying to send the blue L to its exit before the white columns have climbed.
Ignoring the right black column and lifting white into a blocked corner.
